mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.name AS createdByName, u.class_num as classNum FROM tbl_problems p LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY p.problem_id DESC;

SELECT p.*, u.name AS createdByName, -- 작성자 이름 가져오기 (SELECT choice_text FROM tbl_problem_choices WHERE problem_id = p.problem_id AND is_correct = 1 LIMIT 1) AS answer FROM tbl_problems p LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id -- 작성자 정보 조인 WHERE p.problem_id = #{problemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_problem_discussions (problem_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{problemId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW());
mapper.select: SELECT d.discussion_id, d.problem_id, d.user_id, u.name AS createdByName, -- 작성자 이름 추가 u.class_num AS classNum, d.content, d.created_at FROM tbl_problem_discussions d LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON d.user_id = u.user_id -- 사용자 정보 조인 WHERE d.problem_id = #{problemId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC;
